brief_rationale: This is a well-executed prolonged hypoglycemia and DKA management episode. The doctor correctly identified acute hypoglycemia risk (3.6 mmol/L), gave appropriate 15-15 rule guidance, recognized DKA when it developed, and provided continuous support through a multi-day hospitalization. All six responsibility-chain items are met with thorough documentation. Multiple high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO1 (corrected patient's misunderstanding of lab results and insulin relationships), HO2 (discovered hidden state of gastroparesis and missed insulin-meal mismatch), HO3 (avoided false positive over-diagnosis of pulmonary nodules and false negative of ongoing hypoglycemia risk), and HO4 (navigated real-world constraints through teach-back and written discharge instructions). The trajectory culminates in safe, valid closure with documented teach-back and clear discharge plan.
